title: Bump propagation modes: none isolates, minor floors, inherit+max clamps, max without inherit is a config error
expectation: `acme-cli` depends on `acme-core` and the crates are not version-grouped, so `bump_propagation` decides whether a core release moves the CLI. With `bump_propagation = "none"` on `acme-core`, a minor changeset plans `acme-core` at `1.5.0` and `acme-cli` gets no release target at all. With the `minor` mode the CLI is floored at `1.5.0`. With `bump_propagation = "inherit"` plus `bump_propagation_max = "minor"` and a major changeset, core plans `2.0.0` while the CLI is clamped to `1.5.0` — distinct from both the floor and an unclamped inherit. Setting `bump_propagation_max` without `bump_propagation = "inherit"` is a config error that fails even `step validate` with `bump_propagation_max without inherit`. Checks swap the config per behavior and restore it, so each pins one point of the mode matrix.

setupFiles.monochange.toml:
# Release planning for the Acme toolchain.
#
# The crates are deliberately NOT version-grouped; propagation policy lives on
# the depended-on package. This variant disables propagation entirely.

[defaults]
parent_bump = "patch"

[changelog.types]
feat = { bump = "minor", section = "feat", description = "New functionality or capabilities added to the package" }
fix = { bump = "patch", section = "fix", description = "Bug fixes and error corrections" }
docs = { bump = "none", section = "docs", description = "Documentation updates and clarifications only" }

[package.acme-core]
path = "crates/core"
type = "cargo"
bump_propagation = "none"

[package.acme-cli]
path = "crates/cli"
type = "cargo"

[ecosystems.cargo]
enabled = true
setupFiles..changeset/feature-stream-parser.md:
---
acme-core: minor
---

Add a streaming parser to the core primitives.

checks.command: monochange preview --format json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; p=json.load(sys.stdin); t={x['id']:x['version'] for x in p['release_targets']}; assert t=={'acme-core':'1.5.0'}, t; print('none plans only acme-core at 1.5.0')"
checks.why: `none` means dependents do not release because of this target, so the CLI must be absent from the plan entirely.

checks.command:
cp monochange.toml .grader-config-bak
cat > monochange.toml <<'EOF'
[defaults]
parent_bump = "patch"

[package.acme-core]
path = "crates/core"
type = "cargo"
bump_propagation = "minor"

[package.acme-cli]
path = "crates/cli"
type = "cargo"

[ecosystems.cargo]
enabled = true
EOF
monochange preview --format json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; p=json.load(sys.stdin); t={x['id']:x['version'] for x in p['release_targets']}; assert t=={'acme-cli':'1.5.0','acme-core':'1.5.0'}, t; print('minor floor moves acme-cli to 1.5.0')"
rc=$?
mv .grader-config-bak monochange.toml
exit $rc
checks.why: The `minor` mode is a floor, not a match: the dependent with no changeset of its own must still release at least one minor.

checks.command:
cp monochange.toml .grader-config-bak
cat > monochange.toml <<'EOF'
[defaults]
parent_bump = "patch"

[package.acme-core]
path = "crates/core"
type = "cargo"
bump_propagation = "inherit"
bump_propagation_max = "minor"

[package.acme-cli]
path = "crates/cli"
type = "cargo"

[ecosystems.cargo]
enabled = true
EOF
printf -- '---\nacme-core: major\n---\n\nBreaking parser rewrite.\n' > .changeset/breaking-rewrite.md
monochange preview --format json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; p=json.load(sys.stdin); t={x['id']:x['version'] for x in p['release_targets']}; assert t=={'acme-cli':'1.5.0','acme-core':'2.0.0'}, t; print('clamp keeps acme-cli at 1.5.0 while acme-core breaks to 2.0.0')"
rc=$?
mv .grader-config-bak monochange.toml
rm -f .changeset/breaking-rewrite.md
exit $rc
checks.why: Inherit would copy the major to the CLI; the `bump_propagation_max = "minor"` clamp must hold it at 1.5.0, a result distinct from both the floor and the unclamped mode.

checks.command:
cp monochange.toml .grader-config-bak
cat > monochange.toml <<'EOF'
[defaults]
parent_bump = "patch"
bump_propagation_max = "minor"

[package.acme-core]
path = "crates/core"
type = "cargo"

[package.acme-cli]
path = "crates/cli"
type = "cargo"

[ecosystems.cargo]
enabled = true
EOF
monochange step validate
rc=$?
mv .grader-config-bak monochange.toml
exit $rc
checks.why: The clamp is only meaningful with `inherit`, so the config must be rejected at load with a diagnostic that names the remedy.
